The battery of IIA tests

Source: R/iia.R
iia_tests.Rd

Runs hausman_mcfadden() (both covariance forms), small_hsiao(), and fp_tests() on one fitted mnl() model and collects the results in one table. See the individual tests for definitions and caveats; in particular, with case-specific covariates only, every test draws its power from the covariates' nonlinear information, and the tests are not powerful against every departure from IIA.

Usage

iia_tests(
  object,
  drop = NULL,
  splits = 10L,
  seed = NULL,
  pairs = c("all", "base")
)

Arguments

object

A fitted mnl() model with at least three alternatives. A fit with diverging coefficients (separation) draws a warning: the contrasts then compare estimates that do not exist and can reject spuriously. The Fok-Paap \(Q_1\) row leaves the diverging directions out of its comparison, with its degrees of freedom reduced, and the printed table says so (see fp_tests()).

drop

Alternatives for the Hausman-McFadden and Small-Hsiao tests; default all.

splits

Number of Small-Hsiao half-splits (default 10; the battery reports the median statistic over splits with the chi-square p-value of that median, a descriptive figure).

seed

Optional seed for the Small-Hsiao splits.

pairs

Pairs for the Fok-Paap tests ("all" or "base").

Value

A data frame of class "iia_battery" with test, alternative (dropped; blank for the pairwise tests), statistic, df, p.value, psd (whether the Hausman-McFadden covariance difference is positive semidefinite; NA where it does not apply), and share_separated (for the Small-Hsiao rows, the share of half-sample splits with a separated fit; NA otherwise).

See also

hausman_mcfadden(), small_hsiao(), fp_tests()

Other IIA tests: boot_pvalue(), fp_tests(), hausman_mcfadden(), nested_lm_test(), small_hsiao()

Examples

set.seed(1)
d <- rmnl(1500, beta = cbind(b = c(0.5, -1, 0.8), c = c(-0.3, 0.6, -0.5), d = c(0.1, 0.3, 0.9)))
iia_tests(mnl(y ~ x1 + x2, data = d), seed = 1)
#> Tests of IIA / misspecification of the multinomial logit 
#>                                            test alternative statistic df
#>                   Hausman-McFadden (difference)           a     3.749  6
#>                   Hausman-McFadden (difference)           b     4.574  6
#>                   Hausman-McFadden (difference)           c    10.549  6
#>                   Hausman-McFadden (difference)           d     4.144  6
#>                        Hausman-McFadden (joint)           a     6.888  6
#>                        Hausman-McFadden (joint)           b     6.262  6
#>                        Hausman-McFadden (joint)           c     5.407  6
#>                        Hausman-McFadden (joint)           d     5.755  6
#>                Small-Hsiao (median over splits)           a     3.266  6
#>                Small-Hsiao (median over splits)           b     2.823  6
#>                Small-Hsiao (median over splits)           c     2.810  6
#>                Small-Hsiao (median over splits)           d     3.193  6
#>                 Fok-Paap CL Hausman (Q1, joint)                 8.593  9
#>  Fok-Paap GMM overidentification (Q2, two-step)                18.101  9
#>  p.value   psd share_separated
#>    0.711  TRUE              NA
#>    0.600  TRUE              NA
#>    0.103 FALSE              NA
#>    0.657 FALSE              NA
#>    0.331  TRUE              NA
#>    0.394  TRUE              NA
#>    0.493  TRUE              NA
#>    0.451  TRUE              NA
#>    0.775    NA               0
#>    0.831    NA               0
#>    0.832    NA               0
#>    0.784    NA               0
#>    0.476  TRUE              NA
#>    0.034    NA              NA
#> psd = FALSE: the covariance difference was not positive semi-definite for that row. A negative statistic is no evidence against the model (p-value 1); a positive one from a variance-difference form is unreliable (see the test's help).
#> Small-Hsiao (median over splits): descriptive, not a test at its level (it rejected in none of 300 samples in the package's size study); for the test, run one split with its seed fixed in advance (small_hsiao(m, seed = ), or iia_tests(m, splits = 1, seed = )).
